# LaplandDeals

> Live partner deals on Lapland hotels, husky safaris, flights to Rovaniemi and car hire. Last-minute prices, end-of-season clearouts, summer offers.

## Main pages

- [Hotels](https://laplanddeals.com/hotels/): live rates for glass igloos, slope-side stays, family hotels and wilderness lodges.
- [Car hire](https://laplanddeals.com/cars/): winter-ready cars with studded tyres from Rovaniemi, Kittilä, Ivalo and Kuusamo airports, compared on EconomyBookings.
- [Flights](https://laplanddeals.com/flights/): live Trip.com fares from Helsinki to Rovaniemi, Kittilä, Ivalo, Kuusamo (Ruka) and Kemi.
- [Activities](https://laplanddeals.com/activities/): husky safaris, aurora hunts, snowmobile tours, reindeer farms and ice fishing with live GetYourGuide availability.
- [Packages](https://laplanddeals.com/packages/): multi-day trip ideas: aurora week in Saariselkä, family breaks in Rovaniemi, weekend escapes, each block booked at the partner's live rate.
- [Summer](https://laplanddeals.com/summer/): midnight sun stays (June 6 to July 7), hiking season and lakeside cabins.
